text: Figure 5.8: Information path for the CAN Transport Protocols errors during transmission Note: In the figure above, the DCM represents the CANTP user. Other users of CANTP should react similarly (they will receive the indication of failures, and are responsible for initiating a recovery). Another user could be a SWC, with the communication routed to AUTOSAR COM by the PDU Router, or a Complex Driver.
